errors.text: The cited evidence does not directly support the proposed temperature-dependent L12-ordering, APBE, jagged-boundary, or ductility-recovery mechanism in aged AlCoCrFeNi2.1; E3 and E4 concern simulated screw-dislocation behavior in a compositionally and crystallographically different bcc refractory HEA.

The claim that reduced nanoindentation pop-in frequency specifically demonstrates restricted cross-slip is not mechanistically unique; pop-ins are strongly affected by dislocation-source density, surface condition, indentation location, and phase hardness.
